name: Cometary-Nave
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, massive canyon systems emerge like the bones of the planet.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Around the temporal distortion zone, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
